native_description: Native DSL code written directly as text.
loop_description: Repeat the body while the condition holds.
for_description: Repeat the body for a specified number of times; the counter may be named explicitly, otherwise it is named automatically.
assign_description: Set the value of a name to an expression.
plus_description: Addition operator: adds the left and right operands.
minus_description: Subtraction operator: subtracts the right operand from the left.
multiply_description: Multiplication operator: multiplies the left and right operands.
divide_description: Division operator: divides the left operand by the right.
modulus_description: Modulus operator: the remainder of dividing the left operand by the right.
greater_description: Greater-than operator: holds when the left operand exceeds the right.
less_description: Less-than operator: holds when the left operand falls below the right.
greater_equal_description: Greater-or-equal operator: holds when the left operand is not less than the right.
less_equal_description: Less-or-equal operator: holds when the left operand is not greater than the right.
equal_description: Equality operator: holds when both operands are equal.
not_equal_description: Inequality operator: holds when the operands differ.
field_description: Access a member of an owner object.
placeholder_counter: Leave empty to name it automatically
